## 1. The question resolved

The stronger question behind the earlier operational separations was:

> Once a complete statistical profile is fixed, which ordinary quantum capacities can its physical realizations have—and how much output space is needed to change that capacity?

Here “complete profile” retains its precise earlier meaning: the input-labelled RLD quadratic data, equivalently the complete maximal-perspective data, for **every finite reference system, every faithful baseline and every allowed tangent**. It is the invariant classified by
\[
\Omega_E=E(I),\qquad
T_E(X)=\Omega_E^{-1/2}E(X)\Omega_E^{-1/2},
\]
\[
\mathcal A_E=C^*(T_E(M_2)),\qquad
\tau_E(Y)=\tfrac12\operatorname{Tr}(\Omega_EY).
\]

This is a specified family of statistical quantities. It does not assert equality of all operational experiments, trace distances or ordinary relative entropies. The distinction between maximal and standard quantum divergences has substantial antecedents in Hiai–Mosonyi. :chatgpt-content-reference{index="0"}

Let \(\mathcal P_\Gamma\) be the profile of a qubit channel
\(\Gamma:M_2\to M_2\), and define
\[
\mathfrak Q(\mathcal P_\Gamma)
=
\{Q(E):E\text{ is a finite-dimensional realization of }\mathcal P_\Gamma\}.
\]

Using the previously completed profile classification and greatest-representative theorem, the new construction establishes
\[
\boxed{
\mathfrak Q(\mathcal P_\Gamma)=
\begin{cases}
(0,1],&\Gamma\text{ is unitary},\\[2mm]
[0,Q(\Gamma)],&\Gamma\text{ is nonunitary}.
\end{cases}}
\]

These are ordinary, unassisted quantum capacities, in qubits per channel use.

Thus **the unitary-qubit profile is the unique profile in this class that forces positive ordinary quantum capacity in every finite realization**. Every noisy qubit profile admits a zero-capacity realization. More strongly, it admits a realization that can be broadcast to any prescribed finite number of receivers.

The upper endpoint \(Q(\Gamma)\) remains symbolic. This theorem determines the entire range compatible with the profile without supplying an algorithm to evaluate that endpoint.

### The exact output-dimension cost

For \(Q(\Gamma)>0\), the normalized algebra must be \(M_2\). Every faithful representation of that algebra has effective output dimension \(2m\).

If \(m=1\), preservation of the input labels and faithful state forces

## 7. Established boundary

The primary completed result is the **universal finite broadcast construction for noisy qubit profiles**, its **full ordinary-capacity spectrum**, and the **minimum output dimension for every capacity reduction**. The proof covers all Choi ranks and has a generic exact rational implementation.

The earlier thermodynamic, arithmetic, assisted-capacity, catalyst, detector and complete-profile constructions remain preserved unchanged. The independent rank-one-convexity attack produced a useful compatible reduction but no valid negative quasiconvexity witness; it is retained with that status.

The unrestricted quarter-bit approximation problem for ordinary quantum capacity is still not resolved by this work. Neither the spectrum theorem’s symbolic upper endpoint nor the paid heralded inverse supplies the missing ordinary-rate compiler. The new classification establishes exactly what a complete qubit statistical profile permits, including the physical output space required to realize it.
